title: Allocate people and budget across a portfolio
summary: Leaders decide how much to invest in today's products, the next growth areas and future options. Make the split on purpose and review it regularly.

beginner: List the products and initiatives in the portfolio.
Group them into core business, emerging growth and future options.
Show how people and budget are split today.
Propose the split the strategy needs.
Agree it with finance and the sponsor.
intermediate: Use evidence, not history, to set each allocation.
Protect a share for future options so they aren't squeezed out.
Agree triggers to move people and money between areas.
experienced: Review the allocation every quarter against results.
Stop or merge work that no longer earns its place.
Explain the trade-offs openly to teams and leaders.

canDelegateTo.task: Model the current and proposed split

toolExamples.power-bi: Show spend and people by portfolio area.
toolExamples.google-docs: Model the proposed split in a shared sheet.

sources.title: Enduring ideas: the three horizons of growth (McKinsey Quarterly)
